notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Closing the menu on game over will now properly start the next game.
[*]The countdown counts to 1 again, before ending the game.
[*]Fruits can not be dropped on top of the angled wall anymore.
[*]The slider value in the controls menu is now being saved and loaded on game start/end.
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer
notes.content:
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
It took some time, but the multiplayer mode is finally finished. You can now create or join lobbies through Steam and play against each other. I also added a new fruit type, the "Stone Fruit," to annoy your opponent during multiplayer.

[b]Full Mouse Support[/b]
The game now supports full mouse controls. Everything can be done with just the mouse; no keyboard input is needed (though the keyboard is still available).

[b]Background Fruits[/b]
The falling fruits in the background can now be turned off (Menu -> Controls -> Slider).

[b]Stats[/b]
The stats for the current game and your global stats are now separated into two different menus.

Sorry for the long wait; this took longer than expected. I promise to update the game more regularly in the future and release smaller updates in between if one takes too long to implement. Thanks to everyone for waiting and still playing this game; I hope you enjoy the multiplayer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r96raEv.png[/img]

notes.title: Leaderboard
notes.content:
Changed the size of the leaderboard to a maximum of 1100.
You will see 1000 entries around yourself + the top 100.

Also added more font support, now most of your weird names should be visible in the leaderboard.

notes.title: Mouse Input
notes.content:
Fruits can now be moved and dropped with the mouse.
I'll be adding full mouse control in the future (including skills and menu controls), but this has been requested a lot so i wanted to implement this right away.

Also the bug that has been mentioned quit a few times, where 2 fruits would overlap, but not combine is now fixed and shouldn't be happening anymore.

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
Sometimes achievements are not being unlocked due to the request not going through to steam,
Now the request is send again when the game is opened/closed, that should unlock all missing achievements retroactively.
